newsitem.title: USA: Blue Cross to cover cost of Neuromedical product. [CORRECTED 21:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Blue Cross to cover cost of Neuromedical product. [CORRECTED 21:00 GMT]

text.p: Neuromedical Systems Inc said Monday that Blue Cross Blue Shield Mutual of Ohio had agreed to cover the cost of Neuromedical's PAPNET pap smear test for all members (Corrects coverage terms).

The company said Blue Cross and NetMed Inc, which makes the PAPNET product under license, had reached an agreement in which the insurer will cover the cost of the PAPNET test for all its members in the state.
Blue Cross also agreed to "strongly recommend" to its clinicians and laboratories that all negative Pap smears covered by its benefit plans be examined using PAPNET testing, it said.
Neuromedical Systems Inc, which makes PAPNET and other products to help detect early certain cancers, saw its stock rise to 12 in early trading Monday from a close of 11-1/8 Friday.
